caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical floral composition centered around a stylized, reddish-brown plant with swirling stems and leaves. At the top center of the plant sits a bird facing to the left, also rendered in reddish-brown with white accents outlining its shape, wings, and facial features. The bird is holding a small yellow object in its beak. Surrounding the main stem, there are two large, yellow, bell-shaped flowers with red and blue interior details, positioned symmetrically on the left and right. Additionally, four blue, clover-like buds or flowers, two on each side, are attached to the stems above the yellow flowers. The background is a plain off-white, and the entire composition is made up of solid, opaque colors with no shading or gradient.
title: Design from Proposed Portfolio
